scope: Ten distinct creative iteration, comparison handoff, reliability, and interchange improvements in the public tool. Separate private website excluded.

improvements.evidence: Portable recipes across all eight sheet encoders replay as PNG against the pre-encoding processing reference. JPEG cross-cell blocks and sheet-wide GIF quantization may change decoded pixels.

Exact integer coverage: half-alpha GIF boundary on both axes, 625 exact lattice geometries, crop/mask/pixel-scale integration and maximum numerator. Independent 1500-case rational oracle now has zero differences; original sampler fails new regressions.
Decoded white-matte pixels, nonzero origins, bounded writer, cancellation, catalog discovery and no-clobber publication.
Exact decoded straight 8-bit RGBA, tif aliases, nonzero origins, byte limits, cancellation and PNG-only custom DPI.
TestOptionsRejectExplicitFlagOverlap and TestOptionsComposeWithDistinctExplicitFlags; original overlap behavior fails regressions.
Private and public service tests preserve all indices and earlier artifacts; public regression passed 100 repetitions; old truncated-loop overlay fails.

Current host-input acceptance gates local restoration. Repeated paths, replacement/removed masks, host errors/cancellation, invalid arguments and fresh acceptance are checked through state and actual Go-backed AppBridge browser tests.
Both axes, rounding, first-use initialization, hidden fields, changed accepted ratio, invalid blanks, mode reentry, unlocked values, host reset and export limits.
Ctrl/Cmd+Enter from custom colors and advanced JSON; invalid, pending and unsupported-host gating.
Actual browser case retains typed custom colors and advanced options when the selected tab is clicked.

independent_review.coordinator_model: fixed by harness; not changed by prompt
independent_review.structure: Three implementation contexts and six independent verification/review contexts; scheduled within three-worker concurrency limit.
independent_review.repair: One repair phase corrected stale docs and the ratio-lock lifecycle defect; independent browser checks confirmed the final fix.
independent_review.follow_up: Three new independent gpt-6.1-sol ultra contexts performed the requested adversarial audit, implemented scoped supported fixes, and reviewed each other’s fixes.

limits: Local macOS arm64 and Chromium evidence; no hosted CI, native Safari/Firefox, screen-reader, all-host, release or deployment verification.

Area sampling uses display-space RGB from the existing 8-bit pipeline. Integer sums and half-up rounding are exact within admitted geometry; default bilinear output remains unchanged. Tests are not a universal refinement proof.
BMP flattens onto white. TIFF uses uncompressed straight 8-bit RGBA and codec-default72DPI. Custom DPI is PNG-only;32MiB artifact limit remains.
Recipes describe processing before output encoding; JPEG blocks and sheet-wide GIF quantization can change decoded sheet pixels relative to separately encoded cells.

Anonymous initial host notifications have no correlation ID. Hosts must pair them with the current input; overlapping identical arguments cannot be disambiguated. Explicit Apply obtains a correlated preview; source/mask hashes still guard image exports.
Finite models abstract paths, byte hashing, pixels, codecs and UI events; passing them does not prove machine-checked Go/UI refinement.

findings.problem: Floating area totals rounded exact alpha127.5 down to127 and erased the corresponding GIF pixel.
findings.fix: Bounded uint64 coverage and premultiplied totals, rounded half-up only at final byte conversion.
findings.original_failure: 7x2 white source alpha rows [0,0,160,114,162,0,0] and [0,0,160,114,163,0,0], resized5x1: old alpha127/GIFtransparent; fixed alpha128/GIFopaque.

findings.problem: Discard after a repeated source path with a failed/canceled new host input could restore the prior input mask and settings.
findings.fix: Revoke restoration authority before every new input validation; require a preview accepted in the current input epoch through one shared state/UI predicate.

findings.problem: BMP/TIFF were advertised as outputs but missing MIME/alpha/representation roles.
findings.fix: Complete roles for both formats, preserving the original role order; enforce one nonempty role for every advertised output.

findings.problem: Unqualified exact cell-pixel replay was broader than JPEG/GIF encoders can guarantee.
findings.fix: Specify pre-encoding processing recipes; recommend PNG/TIFF for full-alpha pixel comparisons; document JPEG blocks, GIF sheet palette and BMP matting.

independent_checks: Before-fix Go overlays fail alpha/GIF and catalog regressions.
Original bundled AppBridge/Go browser reproduces old mask restoration; fixed failure and recovery controls verified.
Non-author engine/workflow/UI cross-reviews found no remaining supported finding in repaired scope.
Real stdio batch cancellation retains every index and prior committed artifact and leaves connection healthy.
Independent baseline-versus-current experiment confirms anonymous overlapping identical host results are a preexisting SDK correlation limitation.
